title: Administration
subtitle: Feature flags, roles, the audit trail and the recovery bin. Every change here is recorded with who made it and what it was before.

denied.title: Administrators only
denied.description: This screen is for accounts holding the administrator role. If you believe you should have access, write to hello@bsdc.info.bd from the address on your account.

overview.expiring: {{count}} item(s) leave the recovery bin within three days

flags.title: Feature register
flags.subtitle: Every capability is a plugin. All of them ship switched on; switching one off takes the plugin passkey, and can be scheduled to happen between two dates.

passkey.title: Plugin passkey
passkey.description: This feature is protected. Enter the plugin passkey to confirm the change. It is checked on the server and is never stored, logged or sent back.
passkey.label: Passkey
passkey.hint: Five attempts are allowed every fifteen minutes.
passkey.error.BSDC-NET-004: Too many attempts. Wait for the cooldown window to pass.
passkey.error.BSDC-NET-005: The server could not be reached. Nothing was changed.

flags.notePlaceholder: Why this change is being made

members.title: Roles and standing
members.subtitle: Assigning a role is decided on the server. The root role cannot be delegated, and every assignment is written to the audit trail with the reason you give.
members.uidPlaceholder: The account id of the person
members.reasonPlaceholder: Why this person is being given this role
members.reasonRequired: A reason is required before a role can change.
members.ladder: The ladder runs member, verified creator, support, moderator, admin, root. Each step includes the ones below it.
members.rootNote: Only the root administrator may assign a role, and root cannot be handed to somebody else.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.subtitle: Every privileged action, newest first, with what the value was before and what it became. Entries are never edited and never deleted; they are kept for two years.
audit.search: Search by account, target or reason

recovery.title: Recovery bin
recovery.subtitle: Deleted things stay here for thirty days. After that the nightly purge removes them for good.
recovery.empty: The bin is empty. Nothing is waiting to be recovered.
recovery.restored: The item has been put back.
recovery.purged: The item has been deleted permanently.

confirm.title: Delete this permanently?
confirm.description: There is no recovery from this. Type the item id to confirm.
confirm.label: Item id
confirm.mismatch: The id you typed does not match.

recovery.ownerNote: You may restore what you own. Staff may restore anything still inside its window.
